description.narrative: Orange Corners is an initiative of the Netherlands Ministry of Foreign Affairs that provides young entrepreneurs with training, mentorship, network, and facilities to start and scale their businesses. We support innovative solutions to local challenges, that contribute to the UN Sustainable Development Goals. The Orange Corners Delta is implemented in five cities in the the Delta region of Egypt incluidng: Alexandira, Menoufia, Kafr El Sheikh, Dakahleya, Beheira and Kafr El Sheikh
we aim to train and graduate 100 entrepreneurs per year in the five cities, reaching a total of 400 in four years, equiping them with the skills and knowledge to start and grow thier businesses.

we target youth ages 18-35, giving attention to female entrepreneurs, with business ideas in Climate and Water Smart Agriculture, Waste Management, sustainability related startups, tech-based startups and creative industries.

activity-date.narrative: The start date of the agreement is January 1, 2024. Due to delays in the necessary security clearances to commence with the activities, the first project activity started in August 2024.

recipient-country.narrative: the project targets the Delta region in Egypt.

sector.narrative: For business development support, incubation, entrepreneurship.
Specifically for business development services including training, BDS, incubation, marketing
programmatic support to youth with project ideas and businesses in climate and water smart agriculture

description.narrative: budget for a 4 year programme of Orange Corners Delta to support 400 entrepreneurs in 5 cities in the Nile delta region of Egypt, with the training, skills and business development services to start and run a project focusing on climate and water smart agriculture, waste management and sustainability related businesses, while focusing on women empowerment in the targeted cities, and emphasizing on the visibility of the programme among partners, stakeholders and in the local communities.
Budget covering 1st year activities, of 2024 to conduct a mapping study followed by launching Orange Corners Delta in 5 cities in the Nile Delta region to support 100 entrepreneurs.

The plan was to kick start the project activities in January 2024. There were delays in acquiring the necessary security permissions and approvals to start implementation. The security clearance was provided in July 2024. The implementation started in August 2024, causing 8 months delay in delivering partial activities.
covering expenses from the 1st payment of the year 1 activity that were implemented partially in last quarter of 2024, and first half of 2025.
